item.title: ONLY ON 8: Selma mayor reflects on first 100 days in office
item.description: Selma Mayor Johnny Moss III sits down with Action 8 News to discuss his first 100 days in office.

item.title: ‘Inhumane’: Tenant Describes Life Without Water or Heat at West Montgomery Apartments
item.description: Montgomery City Council members also unanimously approved incentive pay for police recruits and passed a resolution reaffirming the city’s commitment to help keep Jackson Hospital open.

item.title: Two Tuskegee men arrested after fires at childcare centers in Opelika
item.description: Opelika police have arrested two Tuskegee men on arson charges following fires at two childcare facilities.

item.title: Bond set at $1 million for mother of missing child in Enterprise
item.description: Bond has been set at $1 million for the mother of a missing two-year-old girl in Enterprise.

item.title: Higher Education Day brings estimated 1,000 people to Alabama State House
item.description: Nearly 1,000 advocates from Alabama’s universities were in Montgomery to show support for higher education at the Alabama State House.

item.title: Montgomery man sentenced for role in mail and bank fraud conspiracy
item.description: A Montgomery man has been sentenced to more than 10 years in federal prison for his role in a mail and bank fraud conspiracy that totaled $9.5 million.

item.title: Local family receives special replacement burial flag after losing the first flag in a house fire
item.description: She had no idea how special it would be.

item.title: Showers & T-storms Friday And Saturday
item.description: Some storms could be strong to possibly severe Saturday.

item.title: U.S. Rep. Terri Sewell, Selma Mayor Johnny Moss, III remember life of Civil Rights leader JoAnne Bland
item.description: U.S. Rep. Terri Sewell and Selma Mayor Johnny Moss, III are two of many people who are pausing to remember the life and work of JoAnne Bland, a Selma Civil Rights leader.

item.title: Gov. Kay Ivey signs legislation putting limits on new environmental regulations
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey has signed legislation that restricts the state’s ability to set new environmental regulations.
